head: codex/5869-epoch-lease-authority
title: [v0.92][WP-04.07] Epoch and lease authority
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5869

## Summary

- add bounded OpenRaft majority and joint-consensus epoch authority
- add canonical domain-separated authority certificates, activation possession, monotonic fencing, and exact mutation authorization
- add restart-safe quorum-proven recovery with precise bounded lease timing

## Validation

- `cargo nextest run --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_lease --no-tests=fail` (16 passed)
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_lease -- -D warnings`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5869/validate-proof-receipt.rb`
- independent exact-head code, security, and lifecycle review: approved with no findings

## Integration boundary

The issue-owned source remains intentionally unregistered until #5878 performs distributed module integration.
